evidence: The signed v1 plugin manifest declares source identity, operations, broker-only authentication scopes, source terms, rate/resource ceilings, data classes, destinations and permissions. Exact Ed25519 verification against a separately trusted local publisher key precedes complete file-hash validation. Unsupported or signed-but-undeclared operations, incompatible SDK major/unknown required features, unsafe paths/destinations and substituted grant/package/project identities fail before any plugin execution API exists.

A Core-owned active per-project grant is an explicit precondition. The immutable authorized-phase provenance contract binds plugin version, permission set, publisher, exact manifest/package/signature digests, grant revision, qualified source ID, operation, invocation ID and Core scientific-request digest. The routing request digest is not wire/replay content. No executed-result, durable consent or LPAC claim is made by T01.

Fourteen fresh signed synthetic package tests pass on the exact candidate. They include valid signed admission, exact-byte/file tamper and untrusted key denial, SDK feature negotiation, namespace and length boundaries, supported-but-undeclared search denial, grant/destination/project substitution, same-version changed-package consent renewal, forged-plan provenance rejection and five public-schema round trips.

The 138-test portable contract suite passes, including the unchanged first-party connector page fixture and historical Git publication witnesses. The first sandboxed run failed only because Git rejected checkout ownership; the successful unchanged rerun used an ignored process-local safe-directory config, not a weakened test or tracked runtime setting.

Five generated Draft 2020-12 plugin schemas (manifest, grant, request, plan and authorized-phase provenance), Core validation, synthetic contract tests, architecture documentation and build-schema inventory were added. The generator check, clean build manifest, architecture, quality, structure, backlog views and backlog validation all pass on the exact commit.

This contract-only task introduces no durable plugin project state, so it requires no storage migration. Actual trusted-key/consent persistence, LPAC dispatch, broker denial/audit, result/response provenance and restart recovery belong to approved CAP-04.S05.T02 and are neither implemented nor claimed here.

verificationSelection.riskAnalysis: T01 changes a public signed-package/security and versioned schema contract. Fresh exact-candidate signed fixture tests, all portable contract tests, generated-schema drift, quality, architecture, clean build inventory and backlog controls cover the changed trust/compatibility surface. The full foundation/service/search/security profiles would repeat unrelated W2 coverage at task scope and remain for the S05 integrated slice/checkpoint/W2 qualification under verification breadth section 8.1.
deferred: CAP-04.S05.T02 owns real LPAC worker isolation, active consent persistence, secret/network broker enforcement, denied-action audit, actual executed-result provenance, crash/cancel/restart and malicious package qualification; T01 publishes only a fail-closed pre-dispatch contract.

Complete foundation/service/search/security-local profiles, live provider paths, packaged worker, native UI/accessibility and representative performance are deferred to the approved S05 slice/checkpoint and fresh W2 exit matrix.
